papers.title: CLIP4Clip: An Empirical Study of CLIP for End to End Video Clip Retrieval
papers.authors: Huaishao Luo, Lei Ji, Ming Zhong, Yang Chen, Wen Lei, Nan Duan, Tianrui Li
papers.affiliations: Southwest Jiaotong University; Microsoft Research Asia; Microsoft STCA
papers.intro: 论文提出CLIP4Clip模型，基于预训练CLIP通过端到端微调和多种相似度计算机制，将图像-文本知识高效迁移到视频-文本检索，并在多个基准数据集上达到SOTA。

papers.title: Frozen in Time: A Joint Video and Image Encoder for End-to-End Retrieval
papers.authors: Max Bain, Arsha Nagrani, Gül Varol, Andrew Zisserman
papers.affiliations: Visual Geometry Group, University of Oxford; LIGM, École des Ponts, Univ Gustave Eiffel, CNRS (Gül Varol)
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于空间-时间Transformer的双编码器模型，将图像视为“冻结在时间中”的单帧视频，通过课程学习联合图像和视频文本数据集进行端到端训练，并贡献了新的视频-文本预训练数据集WebVid-2M，在多个视频检索基准上取得最先进结果。

papers.title: Grounding Open-Domain Instructions to Automate Web Support Tasks
papers.authors: Nancy Xu, Sam Masling, Michael Du, Giovanni Campagna, Larry Heck, James Landay, Monica S Lam
papers.affiliations: Stanford University; Viv Labs, Samsung Research
papers.intro: 本文提出RUSS系统，通过设计领域特定语言ThingTalk将开放域自然语言指令解析为形式化动作，并利用语义解析器和网页元素定位模型，实现高准确率的Web任务自动化。

papers.title: Exploring Cross-Image Pixel Contrast for Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: Wenguan Wang, Tianfei Zhou, Fisher Yu, Jifeng Dai, Ender Konukoglu, Luc Van Gool
papers.affiliations: Computer Vision Lab, ETH Zurich; SenseTime Research
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于像素级对比学习的有监督语义分割方法，通过跨图像像素间和像素-区域间的对比损失，显式地学习结构化更优的像素嵌入空间，从而提升分割性能。

papers.title: WebSRC: A Dataset for Web-Based Structural Reading Comprehension
papers.authors: Xingyu Chen, Zihan Zhao, Lu Chen, Danyang Zhang, Jiabao Ji, Ao Luo, Yuxuan Xiong, Kai Yu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, OCR, gui
papers.affiliations: X-LANCE Lab, Department of Computer Science and Engineering, MoE Key Lab of Artificial Intelligence, AI Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China; State Key Lab of Media Convergence Production Technology and Systems, Beijing, China
papers.intro: 本文提出了WebSRC，一个大规模、多模态的网页结构阅读理解数据集，包含400K问答对和6.4K网页片段（含HTML、截图和元数据），旨在推动机器对网页空间结构和逻辑结构的综合理解。

papers.title: Mapping Natural Language Instructions to Mobile UI Action Sequences
papers.authors: Yang Li, Jiacong He, Xin Zhou, Yuan Zhang, Jason Baldridge
papers.affiliations: Google Research, Mountain View, CA, 94043
papers.intro: 提出一个将自然语言指令拆解为动作短语并接地到移动UI对象上的两阶段模型（动作短语提取 + 接地），并构建三个新数据集，在PIXELHELP上取得70.59%完全匹配准确率。

papers.title: Span-based Localizing Network for Natural Language Video Localization
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Aixin Sun, Wei Jing, Joey Tianyi Zhou
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore; Institute of High Performance Computing, A*STAR, Singapore; Institute for Infocomm Research, A*STAR, Singapore
papers.intro: 本文提出将自然语言视频定位任务重新建模为基于跨度的问答（span-based QA）任务，并设计了一个视频跨度定位网络VSLNet，通过查询引导的高亮策略有效解决了视频与文本之间的差异，在三个基准数据集上取得了最优性能。

papers.title: YOLOv4: Optimal Speed and Accuracy of Object Detection
papers.authors: Alexey Bochkovskiy, Chien-Yao Wang, Hong-Yuan Mark Liao
papers.affiliations: Alexey Bochkovskiy（未公开所属机构）；Chien-Yao Wang 和 Hong-Yuan Mark Liao 均来自 Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica, Taiwan
papers.intro: YOLOv4 通过系统组合多种 Bag-of-Freebies 和 Bag-of-Specials 模块（包括 WRC、CSP、CmBN、SAT、Mish、Mosaic、DropBlock、CIoU 等），在单 GPU 训练条件下实现了速度和精度的最优平衡，在 COCO 数据集上达到 43.5% A…

papers.title: Learning 2D Temporal Adjacent Networks for Moment Localization with Natural Language
papers.authors: Songyang Zhang, Houwen Peng, Jianlong Fu, Jiebo Luo
papers.affiliations: University of Rochester; Microsoft Research
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于二维时间图（2D Temporal Map）的单阶段框架 2D-TAN，通过显式建模视频时刻候选之间的时间相邻关系，实现更精准的自然语言时刻定位。

papers.title: Searching for MobileNetV3
papers.authors: Andrew Howard, Mark Sandler, Grace Chu, Liang-Chieh Chen, Bo Chen, Mingxing Tan, Weijun Wang, Yukun Zhu, Ruoming Pang, Vijay Vasudevan, Quoc V. Le, Hartwig Adam
papers.affiliations: Google AI, Google Brain
papers.intro: 本文通过结合平台感知的神经网络架构搜索（NAS）与NetAdapt算法，并引入h-swish激活函数、重新设计昂贵层以及轻量级分割解码器LR-ASPP，提出了MobileNetV3系列模型，在分类、检测和分割任务上实现了最优的精度-延迟平衡。

papers.title: Anomaly Locality in Video Surveillance
papers.authors: Federico Landi, Cees G. M. Snoek, Rita Cucchiara
papers.affiliations: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia, University of Amsterdam
papers.intro: 论文提出一种基于时空管（spatiotemporal tubes）的异常检测方法，构建了首个训练和测试集均带边界框监督的异常检测数据集UCFCrime2Local，实验证明利用局部性可使模型性能大幅提升，且对定位误差鲁棒并能自动生成弱监督时空提议。

papers.title: YOLOv3: An Incremental Improvement
papers.authors: Joseph Redmon, Ali Farhadi
papers.affiliations: University of Washington
papers.intro: YOLOv3通过多尺度预测（类似FPN）、更深的Darknet-53骨干网络、以及用逻辑回归替代softmax进行多标签分类，在保持实时速度（22-51ms）的同时大幅提升了精度，AP50达到57.9%，与RetinaNet相当且速度快3.8倍。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning on Web Interfaces Using Workflow-Guided Exploration
papers.authors: Evan Zheran Liu, Kelvin Guu, Panupong Pasupat, Tianlin Shi, Percy Liang
papers.affiliations: †Department of Computer Science, ‡Department of Statistics, Stanford University
papers.intro: 本文提出工作流引导探索（Workflow-Guided Exploration, WGE）框架，通过从示范中提取高层工作流来约束智能体的探索动作，结合一个新的神经策略网络DOMNET，在多个网页交互任务上实现了超越先前方法的样本效率和成功率。

papers.title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
papers.authors: Mark Sandler, Andrew Howard, Menglong Zhu, Andrey Zhmoginov, Liang-Chieh Chen
papers.affiliations: Google Inc
papers.intro: 提出MobileNetV2，通过倒残差结构和线性瓶颈层，在保持低计算量的同时大幅提升移动端模型的识别精度，并推广到目标检测和语义分割任务。

papers.title: Real-world Anomaly Detection in Surveillance Videos
papers.authors: Waqas Sultani, Chen Chen, Mubarak Shah
papers.affiliations: 1Department of Computer Science, Information Technology University, Pakistan; 2Center for Research in Computer Vision (CRCV), University of Central Florida (UCF)
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种基于深度多实例排序（Deep MIL Ranking）的弱监督视频异常检测方法，仅利用视频级标签（正常/异常）训练模型，并在新构建的大规模真实世界监控视频数据集上取得了显著优于现有方法的效果。

papers.title: World of Bits: An Open-Domain Platform for Web-Based Agents
papers.authors: Tianlin (Tim) Shi, Andrej Karpathy, Linxi (Jim) Fan, Jonathan Hernandez, Percy Liang
papers.affiliations: Stanford University, OpenAI
papers.intro: 本文提出World of Bits（WoB）平台，利用互联网作为开放域强化学习环境，结合缓存技术、众包任务创建以及行为克隆与强化学习实现智能体训练。

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.authors: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Lukasz Kaiser, Illia Polosukhin
papers.affiliations: Google Brain, Google Research, University of Toronto
papers.intro: 本文提出Transformer架构，完全基于注意力机制（摒弃循环和卷积），实现了在机器翻译任务上更优的质量、更强的并行性和更短的训练时间。

papers.title: MobileNets: Efficient Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Vision Applications
papers.authors: Andrew G. Howard, Menglong Zhu, Bo Chen, Dmitry Kalenichenko, Weijun Wang, Tobias Weyand, Marco Andreetto, Hartwig Adam
papers.affiliations: Google Inc
papers.intro: 本文提出一种基于深度可分离卷积的轻量级神经网络架构MobileNet，并通过两个超参数（宽度乘子和分辨率乘子）允许用户在延迟和准确率之间灵活权衡，在ImageNet分类及多项视觉任务上实现了高效性能。

papers.title: YOLO9000: Better, Faster, Stronger
papers.authors: Joseph Redmon, Ali Farhadi
papers.affiliations: University of Washington, Allen Institute for AI
papers.intro: 提出YOLOv2（改进的实时检测器）和YOLO9000（能检测超过9000类物体的系统），通过联合训练检测和分类数据，实现在实时速度下大幅扩展检测类别，并刷新多项基准精度记录。

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.authors: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren, Jian Sun
papers.affiliations: Microsoft Research
papers.intro: 提出残差学习框架，通过引入恒等快捷连接，使网络能够轻松训练超过100层甚至上千层，并在ImageNet分类、COCO检测等多项任务上取得创纪录结果。
